title: Verify installed module-backed Skill through production M8 root
goal: Add a production-composition integration test proving an installed Skill.md bound to a registered workspace module executes and returns verified output through M8.
context: The generic module-backed executor and trusted registry injection are unit-tested separately. The app composition creates workspace ToolModules when workspaceToolsEnabled, but no test currently proves the complete FileSkillStore -> ModuleRuntime -> WorkspaceReadTool -> verified Skill result path through M8.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass policy or ModuleRuntime capability checks.
Do not instantiate arbitrary executors from Skill.md metadata.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
Do not treat this integration test as proof of on-device UI behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Test creates an installed Skill.md with moduleID tool.workspace.read and exact input/output schema identifiers.
Test creates a searchable workspace text file and invokes the Skill through M8CompositionRoot.executeSkill.
Test confirms the verified tool result contains the matching workspace path.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert the integration test if it reveals an unsupported contract; fix the contract in a separate one-commit task with its own evidence.
